luax functional component + export.description: Typed LUAX component with a ---@class Props block, lexical d.* tags, and a module export. The name is written once and filled into all four places.

luax functional component (local, no exp.description: Typed LUAX component without the module export -- for a sub-component defined alongside others in the same file.

luax requires (hydronium + lexical d).description: The two requires a lexical-tag LUAX file needs: the hydronium barrel and the d intrinsic table. Without the d binding, <d.button> is a nil index at runtime.
